author: Glass Reflection
description:
Cyberpunk Edgerunners Season 2 is finally here, and Netflix actually did the impossible...they told a brand new story with a new cast instead of ruining a completed masterpiece.

In this breakdown, I’m diving deep into the new 10-episode run, analyzing the dynamic between characters like Roman, D, King, and Talia. I break down why this season feels distinctly different from David’s story, explore the controversial inclusion of Capricorn, and unpack that deceptively happy ending. Whether you're wondering if it lives up to the original or trying to make sense of who actually survived, here is my breakdown.
